script: Parasaurolophus may have made sounds like a deep trumpet. It had a long, hollow crest curving back from its head. Air passages ran up and down inside the crest. Computer models of its skull suggest it could make low, booming notes. The crest may also have helped members of a herd recognize each other. It was a duck-billed plant-eater about 9 meters long.
